## Resume: reconcile result

- **Stamps.** Stages 1–3 are all stamped COMPLETE. The stamps are authoritative, so I didn't need a fuzzy match against `specs/plans/completed/`.
- **Handoffs.** Plans 2 and 3 are already cited, in the `Consumes` of Stages 2 and 3. Plan 5's Handoff reads `None`, so it changes no entry. There are no unticked stages to re-validate either way.
- **Amendments and questions.** There are none, so this resume has nothing to commit.

Every stage is ticked and there is no Ranked list, so the next step is the **§6 roadmap-completion review**. That means re-running the gap rubric over R1–R6 against the accumulated system, with evidence for each verdict. This is a conformance audit, not a code-diff review, because each stage was reviewed when it merged.

## Audit reads (next turn, all read-only)

```
Read  specs/parking-occupancy-spec.md                      # R1–R6 text, §2–§4
Read  specs/plans/completed/2-sensor-ingest.md             # Deviation notes, esp. R3 poll interval
Read  specs/plans/completed/3-occupancy-rates.md           # Deviation notes for R4
Read  specs/plans/completed/5-occupancy-dashboard.md       # Deviation notes for R5, R6
Read  specs/deferred_items.md                              # any entries touching R1–R6
Read  sensors/poll.py                                      # confirm R3 is now 5 min (was 15 at :18)
Grep  "bay_events|occupancy|95" across the repo            # locate loader, rate job, dashboard, alert rule
Grep  test files for duplicate-event, hand-count, alert-threshold tests   # Exit evidence per stage
```

Then I'll bring you the completed R1–R6 table. Each row will cite a path:line or test, plus the implementing plan. Any row that isn't implemented-as-specified exits one of two ways:

- **A new stage.** The roadmap stays live.
- **A conscious deferral with a written why.**

I'll put those choices to you as one question.

If every row passes, retiring the roadmap moves this file to `specs/completed/`, beside the retired spec. The methodology and critique files, if any exist, move with it. I'll confirm with you before moving anything.
